title: 1.11 Pets
unit_outcome: Understand and say short German sentences about people and what they are doing.
goal: Name a dog, a cat, a bird and a rabbit, say they are pets, and say what they are doing; animals fressen.
grammar_function: Ein/Eine + animal; Der/Die/Das + animal + verb; Animals: frisst/fressen, not isst/essen.
speaking_outcome: Name the pets and say what they are doing.
